row_guide: Band0: six sidewalk color variants (beige→charcoal) each with fill + straight/outer/inner/curve curbs; asphalt fill and line corners; BUS H/V lanes; zebra crosswalks; P parking H/V; concrete stairs; roundabout road/island/sign/layouts; median islands; driveway slopes. Band1: more composite road layouts; directional arrows (straight/left/right/U/combo); STOP/EXIT/TURN text (H+V); P icons and short line bits; parking-lot example modules with aisle and overlay masks; EV stalls, green hatching, restricted zones. Band2: LimeZu branding / watermark tiles (hatched and framed logos + action icons). Facing-specific curb strips for major sidewalk palettes; full STOP/EXIT/TURN orientations; parking-lot flow arrows; EV borders.
